The '''Ferrelia system''' was a part of the [[Hunnoverrs sector/Legends|Hunnoverrs sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the creature known as the [[Ferrelian ant]].<ref name="Ghostling" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ferrelia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square R-16.<ref name="TEA" />
